entities.summary: Ronald Gerhardus Wilhelmus Cornelissen is a Dutch Roman Catholic clergyman. Since 11 October 2025, he has served as the 4th bishop of the Diocese of Groningen–Leeuwarden. His motto is Perigrinantes in spem.
